title: Launcher IocpPipeRelay buffers stderr by default
desc: Under DETACHED_PROCESS spawn, Core stderr is BUFFERED not passthrough. Default showStderr=false -- stderr only shown on non-zero exit. Use --stderr or --sudo to enable passthrough.
steps: ARCHITECTURE: Launcher/IocpPipeRelay.cs splits stderr -- showStderr=false by default, buffered and printed only on non-zero exit. showStderr=true prints passthrough immediately.
ENABLE PASSTHROUGH: wkappbot --stderr cmd (explicit) or wkappbot --sudo cmd (implicit in v5.14+). PulseStep.Line and Console.Error invisible without passthrough.
TROUBLESHOOTING: If Console.Error.WriteLine invisible -- check --stderr flag. Exit code 0 drops buffer. Use Console.WriteLine (stdout) for always-visible output.
author: claude
